_note: Heuristic coaching ranges for youth/adult amateur players, 2D video. good = no comment needed, warn = mention, outside warn = flag. Views lists where the 2D measurement is trustworthy.

knee_flex_min_deg.label: Knee bend at deepest dip
knee_flex_min_deg.low_cue: Dipping very deep: wastes time, shot becomes slow
knee_flex_min_deg.high_cue: Not enough leg bend: power comes from the arms

elbow_set_deg.label: Elbow angle at set point
elbow_set_deg.low_cue: Ball pulled too far behind the head
elbow_set_deg.high_cue: Arm already straightening before the set point (pushing the ball)

elbow_release_deg.label: Elbow extension at release
elbow_release_deg.low_cue: Arm not fully extended at release (short-arming)

release_height_torso.label: Release point above head
release_height_torso.low_cue: Low release: easy to block, flat arc

dip_to_release_s.label: Time from dip to release
dip_to_release_s.low_cue: Very rushed, legs and arms not linked

release_vs_apex_s.label: Release timing vs top of jump
release_vs_apex_s.low_cue: Releasing early on the way up (fine for a one-motion shot if consistent)
release_vs_apex_s.high_cue: Releasing on the way down: power from legs lost

trunk_lean_release_deg.label: Body lean at release
trunk_lean_release_deg.high_cue: Leaning at release: balance and alignment suffer

landing_drift_torso.label: Drift between take-off and landing
landing_drift_torso.high_cue: Drifting in the air: inconsistent distance/direction

follow_through_s.label: Follow-through hold
follow_through_s.low_cue: Pulling the arm down too fast after release

elbow_alignment_ratio.label: Elbow under the ball (front view)
elbow_alignment_ratio.high_cue: Elbow flares out: ball travels sideways

launch_angle_deg.label: Ball launch angle
launch_angle_deg.low_cue: Flat arc: smaller target at the rim
launch_angle_deg.high_cue: Very high arc: hard to control distance

frequency_hz.label: Dribble rate
frequency_hz.low_cue: Slow, floaty dribble: easy to steal

knee_flex_mean_deg.label: Knee bend while dribbling
knee_flex_mean_deg.high_cue: Standing tall: not in an athletic stance

trunk_lean_mean_deg.label: Forward lean while dribbling
trunk_lean_mean_deg.low_cue: Too upright: hard to protect the ball
trunk_lean_mean_deg.high_cue: Bent over the ball: head likely down
